```{r pfim_report_setup, include=FALSE}
options(kableExtra.latex.load_packages = FALSE)
options(kableExtra.auto_format = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, dpi = 96, fig.retina = 1)
reportTables = params$reportTables
```
